question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** In the sentence, "the camel has a higher body temperature than (3)______ of most mammals," the correct word to complete the comparison is "that." It refers back to** "body temperature,"** making the meaning clear and grammatically correct.
 
• **​In summary, option 2, "that," is the correct choice as it accurately completes the comparative statement about the camel's body temperature in relation to that of most mammals. Options 1, 3, and 4 do not work appropriately in the context of this sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **all:** This option is not appropriate because it does not correctly complete the comparison; the phrase "all of most mammals" doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **the:** This option is incorrect because "the" does not establish a comparison; it needs to be followed by a specific noun when used in this context, which makes the sentence incomplete and unclear.
 
• **some:** This option is incorrect because it would imply partiality, whereas the sentence is making a general comparison between the body temperature of camels and most mammals.
